SD_TELEPHONY.TITLE: 55PBX Telephony
SD_TELEPHONY.DESCRIPTION: Credentials and settings of the 55PBX phone system integration. Everything saved here takes effect immediately in sd-ops, with no file edits or service restarts. Secrets are stored encrypted and never sent back to the browser.

ERRORS.SESSION: Could not validate your sd-ops session. Reload the page.
ERRORS.FORBIDDEN: Only the account administrator can view and change the 55PBX settings.
ERRORS.UNAVAILABLE: The telephony service (sd-ops) is not available in this environment.
ERRORS.CONFLICT: Someone else changed the settings while you were editing. Reload the page and redo your changes.
ERRORS.GENERIC: The operation could not be completed.
ERRORS.VALIDATION: Fix the fields below and save again:

SECRET.WILL_CLEAR: Will be removed on save (falls back to the environment)
SECRET.PLACEHOLDER: New value (leave empty to keep the current one)
SECRET.VAULT_MISSING: Secrets cannot be saved: sd-ops has no SDOPS_SETTINGS_KEY.

INFO.VAULT_MISSING: sd-ops has no SDOPS_SETTINGS_KEY: regular fields can be saved, but secrets (keys and passwords) cannot.
INFO.FORCE_DISABLED: The integration is turned off by the operator on the server (SDOPS_FORCE_DISABLED). Nothing on this page is processed until that is removed.

STATUS.TITLE: Status and activation
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Turns the integration on or off for this account. When off, the webhook answers 503 and reconciliation stops. Activation requires the integration user token and the webhook secret.

API.TITLE: API credentials (Webservice)
API.DESCRIPTION: Key created in the 55PBX panel under Integrations > Webservice (API). Used by Report02, which reconciles calls every few minutes.

WEBHOOK.TITLE: Real-time webhook
WEBHOOK.DESCRIPTION: Register the URL below in the 55PBX panel under "Real time by URL", POST method. Calls arrive through it as they happen.

RECORDINGS.TITLE: Recordings
RECORDINGS.DESCRIPTION: Download of 55PBX recordings, where to keep the copy and how long to keep the raw payload. 55PBX must allow the server IP on the recordings host.

DIAL.TITLE: Dialing (click-to-call)
DIAL.DESCRIPTION: "Automatic dialing to extension" API. Credentials (client_code, api_key and JWT) and the correct URL are provided by 55PBX support. Without them the dial button stays disabled with the reason.

URA.TITLE: IVR (Dynamic Menu)
URA.DESCRIPTION: Credential the 55PBX IVR uses to look up the status of a ticket number.

MAPS.TITLE: Mappings
MAPS.DESCRIPTION: Extension to agent (call assignee and click-to-call extension), queue to team and team to internal area.

TICKETS.TITLE: Ticket opening policy
TICKETS.DESCRIPTION: When each call opens a ticket and when it reuses an open ticket of the same customer. The first active rule, in order, matching direction and queue applies.

HOURS.TITLE: Business hours and SLA
HOURS.DESCRIPTION: Hours used to count SLA deadlines and callback task due dates.

N8N.TITLE: n8n
N8N.DESCRIPTION: Where sd-ops sends automation events and with which HMAC signature. Routes with a relative path use the base URL from here.

ENABLED.LABEL: Integration enabled
ENABLED.HELP: Turns the integration on or off for this account only, immediately.

CHATWOOT_API_TOKEN.LABEL: Integration user token
CHATWOOT_API_TOKEN.HELP: Access token of the "Integração 55PBX" user created by provisioning. Used to create conversations and notes.

PBX_API_KEY.LABEL: Webservice (API) key
PBX_API_KEY.HELP: Key generated in the 55PBX panel (Integrations > Webservice).

PBX_API_KEY_HEADER.LABEL: Key header name
PBX_API_KEY_HEADER.HELP: Assumed to be "key". Confirm with 55PBX support.

POLL_LOOKBACK_MIN.LABEL: Window queried (min)
POLL_LOOKBACK_MIN.HELP: How many minutes back each reconciliation queries Report02.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.LABEL: ServiceDesk public address
PUBLIC_BASE_URL.HELP: Used to build the webhook URL. Empty: the address of this page.

WEBHOOK_TOKEN.LABEL: Header token (optional)
WEBHOOK_TOKEN.HELP: If a key is registered in "Real time by URL", 55PBX sends it in the "token" header and sd-ops starts requiring it.

ALLOWED_IPS.LABEL: Allowed IPs
ALLOWED_IPS.HELP: Source IPs or ranges (CIDR) of 55PBX webhooks. Empty: any IP is accepted (the secret in the URL is still required).

CHATWOOT_WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET.LABEL: ServiceDesk events secret
CHATWOOT_WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET.HELP: Secret of the 55PBX inbox, which signs the events used by the assignment trigger.

DOWNLOAD_RECORDINGS.LABEL: Download recordings
DOWNLOAD_RECORDINGS.HELP: Off: the note keeps only the recording link.

RECORDINGS_HOST.LABEL: Recordings host
RECORDINGS_HOST.HELP: Server where 55PBX serves the audio files (this account uses vsa19.55pbx.com). Used by the connection test.

AUDIO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.LABEL: Hosts allowed for download
AUDIO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.HELP: SSRF protection: downloads only from these hosts. E.g. *.55pbx.com, *.55pbx.com.br

AUDIO_SEND_API_KEY.LABEL: Send the API key on download
AUDIO_SEND_API_KEY.HELP: Turn on if 55PBX requires authentication to download the recording.

AUDIO_BITRATE.LABEL: MP3 quality in the conversation
AUDIO_BITRATE.HELP: 32k is the default. If the originals are WAV49/GSM, use 16k.

CHATWOOT_ATTACH_RECORDING.LABEL: Attach the MP3 to the conversation

STORAGE_BACKEND.LABEL: Where to keep recordings
STORAGE_BACKEND.HELP: Recordings already kept on the local volume remain accessible after switching to S3.

RAW_RETENTION_DAYS.LABEL: Raw payload retention (days)
RAW_RETENTION_DAYS.HELP: LGPD: after this, the raw content received from 55PBX is deleted (processed data is kept).

DIAL_URL.LABEL: Dialing URL
DIAL_URL.HELP: The manual shows two (with and without /pbx). Default: https://ws.55pbx.com:20500/api/webphone/dial

DIAL_JWT.LABEL: JWT (Authorization: Bearer)
DIAL_JWT.HELP: The documentation does not say how to obtain the JWT: ask 55PBX support together with client_code and api_key.

WEBPHONE_URL.LABEL: 55PBX webphone
WEBPHONE_URL.HELP: E.g. https://fone.55pbx.com. Empty: the CTI does not show the webphone shortcut.

URA_TOKEN.LABEL: Token
URA_TOKEN.HELP: At least 16 characters. Register the same value in the 55PBX Dynamic Menu.

URA_REQUIRE_CALLER_MATCH.LABEL: Require the caller to be the ticket phone
URA_REQUIRE_CALLER_MATCH.HELP: On: the status is only spoken if the caller number is the ticket customer's.

QUEUE_TEAM_MAP.LABEL: Queue to team
QUEUE_TEAM_MAP.HELP: Inbound calls arriving through a known queue go to the given team.

BRANCH_TEAM_MAP.LABEL: Extension to team
BRANCH_TEAM_MAP.HELP: Used when the queue does not define the team.

TEAM_AREA_MAP.LABEL: Team to internal area
TEAM_AREA_MAP.HELP: Fills the ticket "Internal area" field from the team.

AGENT_MATCH_BY_NAME.LABEL: Assignee by agent name
AGENT_MATCH_BY_NAME.HELP: Without a mapped extension, uses the ServiceDesk agent with the same name as the 55PBX agent.

N8N_BASE_URL.LABEL: n8n base URL
N8N_BASE_URL.HELP: E.g. https://n8n.example/webhook. Routes registered with a relative path (/sd/wf01) use this base.

N8N_HMAC_SECRET.LABEL: HMAC secret
N8N_HMAC_SECRET.HELP: Signs each event (X-SD-Signature). Takes precedence over the secret configured in the environment for the routes.

MAPS.PBX_EMAIL_PLACEHOLDER: Only if different from the agent e-mail

RULES.NAME: Rule name
RULES.REUSE: Open ticket of the same customer

HOURS.SLA_HELP: Counted only within the business hours above.

CHECKLIST.TITLE: What is missing to go live
CHECKLIST.DESCRIPTION: 55PBX dependencies (D1 to D4 of the schedule) and this account's configuration.

D1.LABEL: Webservice (API) key
D1.HELP: Registered on this page (API credentials section).

D2.LABEL: Real time by URL
D2.HELP: URL generated here and registered in the 55PBX panel; done when the first event arrives.
D2.NO_SECRET: Generate the URL in the Webhook section.

D3.LABEL: Access to recordings
D3.HELP: 55PBX allows the server IP on the recordings host.

D4.LABEL: Dialing (click-to-call)
D4.HELP: client_code, api_key, JWT and live mode.

MAPS.LABEL: Mapped extensions
MAPS.HELP: Extension to agent, in the Mappings section.

ENABLED.LABEL: Integration enabled
ENABLED.FORCED: Turned off by the operator on the server.

TEST.TITLE: Test result
TEST.HINT: Use "Test connection" to check the key on Report02, access to recordings, dialing (only with credentials), the Chatwoot token and n8n. With unsaved changes, the test uses the form values without saving anything.

WEBHOOK.ONLY_ONCE: Copy it now: for security, the full URL is shown only this time. The previous secret is no longer accepted.
WEBHOOK.SOURCE_SEED: Secret registered at installation (only the hash is in the database)
WEBHOOK.ROTATE_CONFIRM: The current secret stops working immediately. Continue?
